decision_basis.density_rule: Do not stack Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday low-aerobic volume merely to manufacture bike touches.
decision_basis.protected_session: Thursday is the first protected MTB window and has priority over a third consecutive trainer day.

session.title: Absorb Tuesday, or replace it if skipped
session.purpose: Preserve Thursday MTB quality by absorbing a completed Tuesday spin, while retaining one low-aerobic replacement option if Tuesday was skipped.

dose.if_tuesday_completed: Rest from planned training. Normal walking and mobility are enough; no bike touch is owed.
dose.if_tuesday_skipped_and_fresh: Complete 45-60 minutes seated at 115-125 W, RPE 2-3, with 125 W as the ceiling.
dose.if_yellow_or_heavy: Rest or complete at most 20-30 minutes at 95-110 W only if it improves the legs.
dose.hard_cap: One branch only. Never add Wednesday volume on top of a completed Tuesday continuity session.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: Choosing either absorption or one replacement aerobic touch maintains bike continuity without carrying avoidable trainer fatigue into the protected technical session.
execution_rules: Use Tuesday completion status before choosing a branch.
If riding, remain seated and conversational with no torque, tempo, intervals or sprints.
Do not use a short Tuesday ride as permission to add a full Wednesday ride.

expected_result.physiology: Thursday begins with normal legs and no accumulated trainer heaviness.
expected_result.weekly_density: Continuity is maintained without sacrificing either protected MTB window.

stop_rules: Do not ride Wednesday if Tuesday's trainer session was completed.
If Tuesday was skipped, stop the replacement spin if RPE exceeds 3, HR is disproportionate, or legs fail to improve by 15 minutes.
Stop for illness symptoms, pain, dizziness, chest symptoms or unusual breathlessness.
